name: Smothered Mate
summary: A knight mates a king hemmed in by its own pieces, capped by the famous Philidor's Legacy queen sacrifice on g8.
intro: Smothered mate is one of the most beautiful patterns in chess: a lone knight checkmates an enemy king that is completely boxed in by its own men. Because the king is smothered by friendly pieces, it has no square to flee to, and only the knight, which leaps over everything, can reach it. The classic realization is Philidor's Legacy, powered by a stunning queen sacrifice.
boardCaption: White plays Nf7+, the knight checking the king on h8 to begin the Philidor's Legacy combination that ends in smothered mate.
line: Nf7+ Kg8 Nh6+ Kh8 Qg8+ Rxg8 Nf7#

sections.heading: The Motif
paragraphs: A smothered mate happens when a king is so surrounded by its own pieces that it has no escape square, and a knight delivers checkmate that nothing can block or capture. Since the knight jumps over other pieces, the wall of friendly units that shelters the king becomes its prison instead. The defender's own material seals its fate.

The famous mechanism is Philidor's Legacy. A knight and queen work together to herd the king into the corner, and a queen sacrifice forces one of the king's own pieces onto the final escape square. With that square blocked, a quiet knight check completes a mate that no amount of material can prevent.

sections.heading: The Line
paragraphs: White opens with 1.Nf7+, checking the king on h8, and 1...Kg8 is forced. Then comes 2.Nh6+, a double check, so the king must move, and 2...Kh8 sends it back to the corner. Now the brilliant 3.Qg8+ arrives, a queen sacrifice that Black is compelled to accept with 3...Rxg8, since the rook must capture and thereby blocks the g8-square.

With the rook now jammed on g8 and the pawns on g7 and h7 completing the cage, the king is utterly smothered. White delivers 4.Nf7#, the knight leaping in to check a king that has no square to run to and no way to block or capture the check. It is checkmate, engineered entirely by the king's own pieces.

keyIdeas: Smothered mate is a knight checkmate against a boxed-in king.
The king's own pieces deny it every escape square.
Philidor's Legacy uses a queen sacrifice to complete the cage.
Nf7+ and Nh6+ drive the king into the corner.
Qg8+ forces Rxg8, blocking the king's last escape square.
Nf7# then delivers checkmate that nothing can parry.
